$comment: The held-migration registry: the ONLY input scripts/held-migration-gate.mjs reads.
`held` = a migration file in this tree whose SQL prod has not applied yet. Add an entry
in the same commit as the migration; delete it in the same commit that flips the
PENDING_MIGRATIONS.md heading to APPLIED. That file keeps the prose (what, risk, order).
`story` and `what` are what docs/operator-worklist.md prints for each entry.
`parked` = a finished migration that lives on a side branch only, not in this tree.
scripts/check-held-branches.mjs asks the remote whether each `branch` exists.
scripts/held-migrations-registry.test.mjs fails when this file and the HELD headings
in PENDING_MIGRATIONS.md disagree, in either direction.

held.what: sellers could overwrite certified photos after grading

parked.what: stop anon enumerating the storage buckets
the deletion log stops claiming a purge it never checked
COMMENTs recording five objects prod has and no migration builds
two brand_knowledge notes that are false in prod
